verdict.rationale: Delaware documents that its 1099 bulk-filing channel accepts only XML and follows the IRS IRIS schema formats, so a machine-readable XML schema exists for that channel. However, it is published by the IRS rather than by Delaware, and it covers only 1099 submissions. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path, and the 'For Tax Software Developers' page is only a heading with no visible schema content. Missing for 10: a Delaware-published schema or data dictionary of its own, coverage beyond 1099 (e.g. withholding, gross receipts), any OpenAPI or API spec, and independent corroboration that the schemas are actually usable.
